en.refuse_subsidence_size: The size of the subsidence response is withdrawn from the answer: it is not supported by the registered tests. The page shows the model's numbers under Model internals.
en.refuse_area: The area sinking faster than a threshold is withdrawn from the answer. The page shows it under Model internals.
en.refuse_recommendation: This tool reports what the model shows for a policy; it does not choose one.
en.refuse_volumes_money: The page gives no pumping volumes, land areas or monetary costs, so they are not answered. The cost it shows is pumping energy given up.
en.refuse_observations: Individual wells and benchmarks are not answered here.
en.refuse_beyond_horizon: The page ends at its horizon; later years are not answered.
en.refuse_out_of_domain: This tool answers questions about the twin decision page only.
en.refuse_provider_refusal: The language model declined to route this question. Use the presets or the form.
en.refuse_township_head: Head change for a single township is not offered: the claims ledger does not map it yet. The page's head answer is the mean at the registered Yunlin monitoring wells.
en.refuse_no_policy: Choose a policy first: under business as usual there is no policy effect to report.
en.refuse_no_run: The page has no number for this setting.
en.refuse_disabled: This question type is not enabled yet.
en.frame_open_page: Open this state in the page
en.frame_rail_verdict: The page gives no verdict on the rail: its numbers are model internals.
en.frame_cheapest: A search over the page's own lever settings for the lowest pumping energy that reaches the head target; carrying the head response to a single class is a model-only transfer.
en.frame_scoring_due: A registered test is due to be scored for this claim, and the ledger records no result yet; no confidence statement is made.
en.frame_not_validated: Answers describe this model, not observed outcomes.
en.banner_dev_pending: Development build: the claims ledger still has a pending registration.
en.banner_dev_unbound: Development build: the page and the ledger pins were not checked.
en.banner_stale_wording: A scheduled scoring date for this release has passed; the wording may be out of date.
